When Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu arrived in New York to [address
the UN General Assembly](https://zeteo.com/p/netanyahu-slams-mamdani-and-
piker), he was greeted by a [mass
walkout](https://www.facebook.com/newshour/videos/dozens-of-delegates-walked-
out-as-israeli-prime-minister-benjamin-netanyahu-addr/1415678877193667/)
inside the hall and [mass
protests](https://www.theguardian.com/news/video/2026/sep/25/protests-erupt-
as-netanyahu-gives-inflammatory-un-speech-the-latest) on the streets.

It was yet another sign that the man wanted on war crimes charges is
increasingly isolated on the world stage as Palestinians and their supporters
prepare to mark three years since Israel's genocidal war in Gaza began.

Unfortunately, however, the growing opposition has done nothing to stop Israel
from its actions. Just this week, Israeli forces continued to kill children,
reportedly dropped "skunk water" on Palestinians in Gaza, and demolished the
homes of around 180 Palestinians in the occupied West Bank.
